name: Peld
title: Ferryman
examine: Pond-water calm. His hands look idle. They know every current in the millpond.
lines: P-pond's quiet today. Best kind of day.
I walked up from Saltmere country when I was small. One day I'll pole somebody the whole way back d-down.
Garton grumbles about my bell. He still checks the pond every morning to see I'm on it.
